<p align="center">Extract tables and text from PDF files in Node.js.</p>

[![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/pdf-reader.svg)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/pdf-reader) [![CI](https://github.com/example/pdf-reader/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/example/pdf-reader/actions)

# pdf-reader

## Features

- Extract tables from PDF pages
- Read text with page numbers
- Fill simple PDF forms

## Install

```bash
npm install pdf-reader
```

## Usage

```js
// Add a blank page to the document
import { read } from 'pdf-reader';
```
